{"operation":"Checking for the other Abhyasi's booking for Prakash's target sitting","agent":"Operation Agent","operation_dict":{"operation_type":"DEVTOOLS_NETWORK_QUERY"},"reasoning":"whether the other Abhyasi booking for sitting {{global.race_slot}} is present (in the other Abhyasi's booking list)","variable":{},"secrets":{},"params":{},"code":"posts = network.requests(method='POST', path='/api/abhyasi/bookings')
slot_id = json.loads(posts[-1].response_body)['slotId']
created_abhyasi = json.loads(posts[-1].response_body)['abhyasiId']
booking_reads = network.requests(method='GET', path='/api/abhyasi/bookings')
return any(json.loads(r.response_body) and any(b.get('slotId') == slot_id and b.get('abhyasiId') not in (None, created_abhyasi) for b in json.loads(r.response_body)) for r in booking_reads)","code_js":"const posts = network.requests({method:'POST', path:'/api/abhyasi/bookings'}); const slotId = JSON.parse(posts[posts.length - 1].responseBody).slotId; const createdAbhyasi = JSON.parse(posts[posts.length - 1].responseBody).abhyasiId; const reads = network.requests({method:'GET', path:'/api/abhyasi/bookings'}); return reads.some(r => { const body = JSON.parse(r.responseBody); return body.some(b => b.slotId === slotId && b.abhyasiId != null && b.abhyasiId !== createdAbhyasi); });"}
